## Purpose

Analyses exposure of pilot, crew and bystanders to noise, whole-body vibration, exhaust, heat,
chemicals, battery off-gas, ergonomic load and rotor noise.

## SysML model

SysML v2 textual view: [`Task207_HHA.sysml`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/safety/mil-std-882e/02-hazard-identification/task-207-health-hazard-analysis/Task207_HHA.sysml), generated from the catalog. It imports the project model in [`models/sysml/model`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/tree/main/models/sysml/model): `SusanooArchitecture` (elements and usage paths) and `SusanooLibrary` (882E vocabulary). The figures are drawn from the same data; the `.sysml` file is the model of record.

// Task207_HHA — generated by tools/gen_safety_docs.py from safety/mil-std-882e/catalog.yaml.
// Do not edit by hand: change the catalog and regenerate.
// Status: planning view only; not evidence of completed analysis or verification.

package Task207_HHA {
    private import ScalarValues::*;
    private import SusanooLibrary::*;
    private import SusanooArchitecture::*;
    item def HealthExposure {
        attribute agent : HealthHazardAgent;
        attribute source : String;
        attribute exposedPopulation : String;
        attribute exposureLimitRef : String;
        attribute measured : Boolean;
    }
    enum def HealthHazardAgent {
        enum Acoustic;
        enum Vibration;
        enum Chemical;
        enum Thermal;
        enum Ergonomic;
        enum Biological;
        enum Radiation;
    }
}
